title: 第11章 五湖四海之水听我号令第12章 芥子袋为群妖讲解地仙之道
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 接下来便是那门神通，控水术。
这门神通看起来普普通通，但叶云的兴趣很大，因为颇为实用。
一旦掌握，就能操控天下之水。
届时，一切江海湖泊，乃至是四海，对他来说，都如履平地，畅通无阻。
“到时候可以去四海龙宫一趟。”
毕竟，上至仙神，下到凡人，没有一个不知道，四海龙宫很富有。
叶云觉得，不管是无量剑胎需要的兵器和特殊之物，还是自己需求的天材地宝。
这四海龙宫里肯定有，而且还有很多。
所以，这四海龙宫，他肯定是要去的。
按捺下这些念头，叶云遂开始参悟这控水术。
说是参悟，其实就是完完整整的看一遍。
然后面板上就出现了控水术。
完全入门只需要一千进度点，对比他学的三道神通，少了十倍。
不过也很正常，这控水术很明显是那种很普通的神通。
自然跟太白剑经的三大神通不能相提并论。
但实用性还是拉满的。
叶云此时已经初步掌握，开始不断练习。
花费了半月时间，他就已经彻底掌握了，达到圆满层次。
叶云有心想要试试，便走出了洞府。
控水术施展，顿时这附近天地之中的水行之力朝着他汇聚而来。
如同臣子朝见帝王，无比恭敬温顺，没有丝毫抵抗的意思。
不多时，叶云脚下便汇聚出了一条长河，他足踏万千水流，所过之处，万水为其开路。
“不错，等以后我境界高了，再施展这控水术，一声敕令，五湖四海之水都要听我号令……”
叶云想到那个场面，顿时觉得逼格爆炸。
更甚者，甚至天河之水，也不在话下。
嗯？
就在这时，叶云感应到流沙河之中，有陌生的妖气出现。
“看来有不速之客……”
叶云身化剑光，瞬间消失不见。
content_en:
Next is the magical power, water control.
This magical power seemed ordinary, but Ye Yun was very interested in it because it was quite practical.
Once you master it, you can control the water in the world.
At that time, all rivers, seas, lakes, and even the four seas will be as smooth as walking on the ground and unimpeded to him.
"You can go to the Sihai Dragon Palace then."
After all, everyone from gods to mortals knows that Sihai Dragon Palace is very rich.
Ye Yun felt that whether it was the weapons and special items needed by the Infinite Sword Embryo, or the heavenly materials and earthly treasures he needed.
There must be some in the Four Seas Dragon Palace, and there are many more.
Therefore, he must go to the Four Seas Dragon Palace.
After suppressing these thoughts, Ye Yun began to understand the water control technique.
To say it is to comprehend, in fact, is to read it completely.
Then the water control technique appeared on the panel.
[Water Control (Introduction 01000)]
It only takes a thousand progress points to fully get started, which is ten times less than the three magical powers he learned.
But it's normal. This water control technique is obviously a very common magical power.
Naturally, it cannot be compared with the three great magical powers of the Taibai Sword Classic.
But the practicality is still full.
Ye Yun had already initially mastered it and began to practice continuously.
It took him half a month to completely master it and reach the level of perfection.
Ye Yun wanted to give it a try, so he walked out of the cave.
The water control technique was cast, and the power of water in the nearby heaven and earth suddenly gathered towards him.
Just like a minister meeting an emperor, he is extremely respectful and docile, without the slightest intention of resisting.
Not long after, a long river formed under Ye Yun's feet. He stepped on thousands of currents, and wherever he passed, thousands of rivers opened a path for him.
"That's right. When I reach a higher level in the future, I can use this water control technique again. With an order, all water in the world will obey my orders..."
When Ye Yun thought of that scene, he suddenly felt overwhelmed.
What's more, even the water of the Tianhe River is not a problem.
Um?
At this moment, Ye Yun sensed that there was a strange evil spirit appearing in the Liusha River.
"It seems there are uninvited guests..."
Ye Yun transformed into sword light and disappeared instantly.
